svg.aria-label: Upper voice: E4 4 to 10 s, F4 14 to 20 s, E4 26 to 32 s (rests in between). Lower voice: C4 0 to 36 s. Sounding pairs: 4 to 10 s: C4 + E4, major third; 14 to 20 s: C4 + F4, perfect fourth; 26 to 32 s: C4 + E4, major third. Colour bands mark only the times when both voices sound.
svg.title: Version A: one voice holds the landscape

g.text: Version A: the lower voice holds
Colour appears only while both voices sound.
At rests there is no pair, so no colour.
How to read this graphic: Colour bands appear
only while both voices sound; where the upper
voice rests there is no pair, so there is no
colour. Read the band labels left to right:
M3 for 4 semitones, P4 for 5, M3 again. The
lower voice is the same note under all three.
